subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel/account-level WhatsApp heartbeat recipient contract for OK acknowledgments only, separate from alert/content delivery, and what exact shape should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear from source, but adding public channel config affects compatibility, precedence, validation, and the boundary between agent heartbeat delivery and channel visibility.

options.title: Approve OK-only recipient config
options.body: Add a narrow `target`/`targets`-style channel or account heartbeat recipient shape that applies only to `HEARTBEAT_OK` acknowledgments and validates through WhatsApp account and allowlist policy.

options.title: Reject new channel config
options.body: Keep the existing choices of `showOk: false` for silence or agent-level `heartbeat.target` plus `to` when all heartbeat delivery should go to one recipient, then close the feature direction.

options.title: Defer to broader routing design
options.body: Keep this issue as design input while maintainers choose a cross-channel heartbeat recipient model or sequence it after WhatsApp outbound-policy refactors.

recommendation.title: Approve OK-only recipient config
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `target`/`targets`-style channel or account heartbeat recipient shape that applies only to `HEARTBEAT_OK` acknowledgments and validates through WhatsApp account and allowlist policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history across heartbeat/outbound routing and participated in the existing maintainer-facing review discussion for this exact issue.
